instruction: I want to show weekday in the clock at the top bar so I always know what day it is. Can you enable this?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling weekday display in clock. Evaluator verifies the clock-show-weekday setting is set to true using exact_match metric with vm_command_line getter.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks the exact system setting (clock-show-weekday) that controls weekday display in GNOME top bar
Getter (vm_command_line) with gsettings command extracts the right state for verification
Metric (exact_match) appropriately compares boolean setting value
Expected value 'true\n' is semantically correct and includes the newline character from shell command output
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (enable weekday display) and evaluator verifies exactly that
No postconfig needed - setting persists and can be read anytime after task completion
No edge cases or timing issues - simple boolean setting verification
